comment: NPC beast head slots (cosmos_chimera docs/design/npc-uma-looks.md#獸頭). One entry per race whose whole face is reshaped (NpcMeshes HeadSlotOf); npc_beast_head.py grows each on that race's two bases. Positions and sizes are the procedural head's (NpcMeshes.Head), in head radii from the head centre: x right, up, fwd forward. Rigid parts (ears, beak, horns, fins, crest, barbels, spines) stay procedural and ride on the slot.
eye_comment: Eye centre on the skull's front at (x, up); size against the procedural default 0.12 scales the base's own eyeball, which keeps its eye.* keys.
snout_comment: A tapering tube from `from` forward by the snout length (head radii), dropping `drop` per unit length, radius r0 at the root and r1 at the tip; the basis is drawn at min and the npc_snout key at max (Look's per-resident draw lies between). tone: the tube takes its own material (a resident's muzzle is lighter or darker than the skin); without it the tube is skin.
ruff_comment: The werewolf ruff: the procedural neck ball (r.Neck, TrunkX x 1.02, 0.07 x height, TrunkZ x 1.5) at size min in the basis and max in the npc_ruff key.
